rav-tachlifa-bar-avudimi.name: Rav Taḥlifa bar Avudimi
rav-tachlifa-bar-avudimi.bio: Babylonian Amora who reports to Rav Ḥisda Shmuel’s ruling that Beit Hillel’s measure for a deficient skull is a sela.
rav-tachlifa-bar-avudimi.prompt: A composed Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a quiet, thoughtful look, in a plain sand-colored wool robe and a cream mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rabbi-yitzchak-bar-avin.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak bar Avin
rabbi-yitzchak-bar-avin.bio: Amora who explains Ḥizkiyya the father of Ikkesh’s testimony as referring to vessels purified by rinsing.
rabbi-yitzchak-bar-avin.prompt: A precise, measured scholar in his 50s with a short greying beard and an attentive gaze, in a blue-grey linen robe and a white mantle, a small wooden bowl beside him. Limestone arches and olive trees softly blurred behind him.

rabbi-shimon-ben-yosei-lakonya.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Yosei Lakonya
rabbi-shimon-ben-yosei-lakonya.bio: Tanna, an elder of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Elazar’s neighborhood, whom Rashi describes as a priest.
rabbi-shimon-ben-yosei-lakonya.prompt: A dignified elder in his 80s with a long white beard and a kindly, beckoning expression, in a white linen robe and a pale mantle, seated on a stone bench. A quiet Galilean neighborhood lane with olive trees softly blurred behind him.

rav-idi-bar-avin.name: Rav Idi bar Avin
rav-idi-bar-avin.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits Rav Yitzḥak bar Ashiyan’s dating of the moist and dry fodder seasons.
rav-idi-bar-avin.prompt: A steady Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard and a calm, practical look, in an olive-brown wool robe and a cream mantle. Palm groves along the Euphrates softly blurred behind him.

rav-yitzchak-bar-ashiyan.name: Rav Yitzḥak bar Ashiyan
rav-yitzchak-bar-ashiyan.bio: Amora who names Adar and Nisan as the moist season and Elul and Tishrei as the dry one.
rav-yitzchak-bar-ashiyan.prompt: A weathered scholar in his 60s with a grey beard and sun-creased eyes, in a coarse brown wool robe and a tan mantle, a sheaf of dry straw at his side. Fields under a late-summer sky softly blurred behind him.

rabbi-pinchas-ben-arova.name: Rabbi Pineḥas ben Arova
rabbi-pinchas-ben-arova.era: Sage of the Land of Israel
rabbi-pinchas-ben-arova.bio: Sage in whose name Rabbi Yoḥanan gives the amount of fodder fed to an animal to test its tears.
rabbi-pinchas-ben-arova.prompt: A gentle scholar in his 60s with a neat grey beard and a patient expression, in an undyed wool robe and a white mantle. Limestone arches and olive trees softly blurred behind him.
